items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1972-05-27
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] No, it's Gettison Moss, isn't it? ... [INTERVIEWEE] That's Gettison really something.

ctx.x: Well, he used to run those joints around. The alley. The alley. And there was one across the street on Claiborne that's the Martyrera there now. Louisiana?
No, it's Gettison Moss, isn't it? Well, wait a minute. There's the Louisiana, the Rhodes.
No, no, you go back now to Claiborne and Salernon on the other side. That's Gettison really something.
